profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat

positions.title: IT Business Analyst
positions.description: IT Business Analyst with the technical intern co-op program at Siemens for a final semester.

positions.title: Undergraduate Game Development Researcher
positions.description: Programming a library that provides functionality for multimedia devices in Hunt Library. Creating the functionality for users to write scripts that control the Spyder smart projection systems using Python.

positions.title: IT Business Analyst
positions.description: IT Business Analyst/Project Manager with the technical intern co-op program at Siemens for two consecutive semesters.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Solved high-level problems with lower-level solutions. Queried databases to find and correct inaccuracies in data. Created the wireframe for the company website in order to facilitate many processes in the company, as well as to create a visually pleasing layout for customers' online data modification.

I returned to the company from the previous year at a higher position, even though I was still an intern. I gained experience with problem solving, spreadsheets, databases, web design, and communication with customers and other companies.

positions.title: Junior Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Solved technical problems of varying degree. Queried databases to find and correct inaccuracies in data. Set up a test environment to aid with some of the issues discovered from extensive data analysis.

I gained experience with problem solving, spreadsheets, and databases. I learned how to solve computer and server problems based on symptoms and narrowing down possible solutions. I gained lots of experience with Windows XP and Windows Server.
